jp: ご主人様、ご無事で！この屋敷に集まりつつあった増援の悪魔たちは、どうやら親玉を失ったことでみんな逃げて行ったみたいですよ！
jp_grezzo: "ご主人様、ご無事で！この屋敷に集まりつつあった増援の悪魔たちは、どうやら親玉を失ったことでみんな逃げて行ったみたいですよ！"
en: Master, I'm glad you're safe! More of those disgusting creatures were gathering, but it looks like they all ran away after the leader was killed!
en_grezzo: "Master, I'm glad you're safe! More of those disgusting creatures were gathering, but it looks like they all ran away after the leader was killed!"
it: Padrone, meno male, stai bene! Se ne stavano radunando altri, di quegli esseri ripugnanti, ma pare che alla morte del capo siano scappati tutti!

jp: そうそう、地下室への階段前にこんなものが落ちていたんです。清掃業者さんの物でしょうか？とりあえずご主人様に渡しておきますね。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう、地下室への階段前にこんなものが落ちていたんです。清掃業者さんの物でしょうか？とりあえずご主人様に渡しておきますね。"
en: Oh yes, and I found this in front of the stairs. Maybe the exterminator is the one who left it there? Anyways, I think you should have it, Master.
en_grezzo: "Oh yes, and I found this in front of the stairs. Maybe the exterminator is the one who left it there? Anyways, I think you should have it, Master."
it: Ah, e davanti alle scale del sotterraneo c'era questa. L'avrà lasciata la disinfestazione? Comunque è giusto che la tenga tu, Padrone.

jp: え～っと…これ、メイドの皆で作ったんです。よかったら食べてください。お口に合うといいんですけれど…。
jp_grezzo: "え～っと…これ、メイドの皆で作ったんです。よかったら食べてください。お口に合うといいんですけれど…。"
en: Umm... This is something we all made for you. Please try it if you would like. I hope the taste is to your liking...
en_grezzo: "Umm... This is something we all made for you. Please try it if you would like. I hope the taste is to your liking..."
it: Ehm... questo l'abbiamo preparato tutte insieme, noi cameriere. Assaggialo, se ti va. Spero che sia di tuo gusto...

jp: 地下に行く
jp_grezzo: "地下に行く"
en: I want to go to the basement.
en_grezzo: "I want to go to the basement."
it: Scendere nel sotterraneo

jp: 地下に害虫駆除に行く
jp_grezzo: "地下に害虫駆除に行く"
en: I'll get rid of the bugs in the basement.
en_grezzo: "I'll get rid of the bugs in the basement."
it: Scendere a disinfestare il sotterraneo

jp: キッチンに虫がいたんだけど
jp_grezzo: "キッチンに虫がいたんだけど"
en: Some bugs damaged the kitchen.
en_grezzo: "Some bugs damaged the kitchen."
it: Degli insetti hanno rovinato la cucina

jp: 気持ちいいことしない？
jp_grezzo: "気持ちいいことしない？"
en: Wanna have some fun?
en_grezzo: "Wanna have some fun?"
it: Ti va qualcosa di bello?

jp: ここ、こんなに埃が残ってるよ
jp_grezzo: "ここ、こんなに埃が残ってるよ"
en: There's too much dust here.
en_grezzo: "There's too much dust here."
it: Qui c'è ancora tutta questa polvere

jp: 頑張ってるね
jp_grezzo: "頑張ってるね"
en: You've done well.
en_grezzo: "You've done well."
it: Stai lavorando bene

jp: 何か御用でしょうか？
jp_grezzo: "何か御用でしょうか？"
en: Is there something I can help you with?
en_grezzo: "Is there something I can help you with?"
it: C'è qualcosa che posso fare per te?

jp: そ、その…あまりいじめないでください…。
jp_grezzo: "そ、その…あまりいじめないでください…。"
en: U-umm... Please don't tease me so much...
en_grezzo: "U-umm... Please don't tease me so much..."
it: E-ehm... non infierire così, ti prego...

jp: す、すみませんすみません！すぐに掃除しなおします！
jp_grezzo: "す、すみませんすみません！すぐに掃除しなおします！"
en: I'm sorry! I'm so sorry! I'll clean it again immediately!
en_grezzo: "I'm sorry! I'm so sorry! I'll clean it again immediately!"
it: Scusa! Scusami tanto! Rifaccio subito le pulizie!

jp: も、もういいじゃないですかその話は！
jp_grezzo: "も、もういいじゃないですかその話は！"
en: T-That's enough of that kind of talk!
en_grezzo: "T-That's enough of that kind of talk!"
it: B-basta con questi discorsi!

jp: え、えっちなのはいけないと思います！
jp_grezzo: "え、えっちなのはいけないと思います！"
en: I-I think that dirty thoughts are bad!
en_grezzo: "I-I think that dirty thoughts are bad!"
it: I-io penso che le cose sconce siano sbagliate!

jp: …え？あれ？気持ちいいことって、そういうことじゃないんですか…？
jp_grezzo: "…え？あれ？気持ちいいことって、そういうことじゃないんですか…？"
en: ...Huh? When you said \"have some fun\", is \"that\" not what you meant...?
en_grezzo: "...Huh? When you said \"have some fun\", is \"that\" not what you meant...?"
it: ...Eh? Come? Quando hai detto \"qualcosa di bello\", non intendevi \"quello\"...?

jp: ぶっ！？だ、ダメです！ダメですそんなの！し、仕事に戻らせていただきます！
jp_grezzo: "ぶっ！？だ、ダメです！ダメですそんなの！し、仕事に戻らせていただきます！"
en: Mmgh!? N-No! Absolutely not! I-I have work to go do!
en_grezzo: "Mmgh!? N-No! Absolutely not! I-I have work to go do!"
it: Ghh!? N-no! Assolutamente no! T-torno al lavoro!

jp: ！ご主人様も遭遇しましたか…。あのおぞましき悪魔達は地下から侵入してきているようで、何度駆除してもきりがないんです。先日、地下に清掃業者を送り込んだのですけど誰一人として帰ってきませんでした…。いったいどうすれば…。
jp_grezzo: "！ご主人様も遭遇しましたか…。あのおぞましき悪魔達は地下から侵入してきているようで、何度駆除してもきりがないんです。先日、地下に清掃業者を送り込んだのですけど誰一人として帰ってきませんでした…。いったいどうすれば…。"
en: ! So you noticed, Master... Those disgusting creatures came up from underground. We've tried to get rid of them several times, but there's just no end to them. We sent some bug exterminators down there a few days ago, but not a single one came back... I don't know what in the world we're going to do...
en_grezzo: "! So you noticed, Master... Those disgusting creatures came up from underground. We've tried to get rid of them several times, but there's just no end to them. We sent some bug exterminators down there a few days ago, but not a single one came back... I don't know what in the world we're going to do..."
it: ! Allora l'hai notato anche tu, Padrone... Quegli esseri ripugnanti salgono dal sotterraneo, e per quante volte li scacciamo non finiscono mai. Giorni fa abbiamo mandato giù dei disinfestatori, ma non è tornato nessuno... Non so proprio come fare...

jp: 危険は承知の上だ
jp_grezzo: "危険は承知の上だ"
en: It's a risk I'm willing to take.
en_grezzo: "It's a risk I'm willing to take."
it: Il rischio me lo prendo

jp: じゃあやめる
jp_grezzo: "じゃあやめる"
en: I won't go then.
en_grezzo: "I won't go then."
it: Allora lascio stare

jp: ご主人様自ら駆除に向かわれるのですか！？そんな！危険です！
jp_grezzo: "ご主人様自ら駆除に向かわれるのですか！？そんな！危険です！"
en: Let you handle it, Master?! We can't! It's too dangerous!
en_grezzo: "Let you handle it, Master?! We can't! It's too dangerous!"
it: Vuoi andarci tu, Padrone?! Non se ne parla! È troppo pericoloso!

jp: それがいいですよ！また今度業者に頼みましょう。
jp_grezzo: "それがいいですよ！また今度業者に頼みましょう。"
en: Good! Let's give the exterminators another try.
en_grezzo: "Good! Let's give the exterminators another try."
it: Meno male! Riproviamo con i disinfestatori.

jp: …止めても無駄の様ですね。わかりました、地下へは私が案内いたします。どうぞこちらへ…。
jp_grezzo: "…止めても無駄の様ですね。わかりました、地下へは私が案内いたします。どうぞこちらへ…。"
en: ...It doesn't look like I can stop you. Okay, I'll guide you to the basement. Please follow me...
en_grezzo: "...It doesn't look like I can stop you. Okay, I'll guide you to the basement. Please follow me..."
it: ...Vedo che non c'è verso di fermarti. Va bene, al sotterraneo ti accompagno io. Di qua, prego...

jp: え…。また地下室へ行かれるのですか？アイテム整理ですか？ま、まさかそれとも悪魔たちの残党がまだ…！？と、とにかくご案内しますね。
jp_grezzo: "え…。また地下室へ行かれるのですか？アイテム整理ですか？ま、まさかそれとも悪魔たちの残党がまだ…！？と、とにかくご案内しますね。"
en: What...? You want to go the basement again? Do you need to organize the items there? B-But surely there are still some remnants of those devils...?! A-Anyways, please follow me.
en_grezzo: "What...? You want to go the basement again? Do you need to organize the items there? B-But surely there are still some remnants of those devils...?! A-Anyways, please follow me."
it: Come...? Vuoi tornare nel sotterraneo? Devi sistemare la roba che c'è laggiù? M-ma non è che ci sono ancora dei resti di quei demoni...?! C-comunque ti accompagno, di qua.

jp: もう…そんなに褒めても何も出ませんよ♪
jp_grezzo: "もう…そんなに褒めても何も出ませんよ♪"
en: Geez... There's no need to praise me that much~ You're embarrassing me!
en_grezzo: "Geez... There's no need to praise me that much~ You're embarrassing me!"
it: Uffa... non lodarmi così tanto, mi fai vergognare!

jp: はい、ありがとうございます。…えへへ、ほめられちゃった。
jp_grezzo: "はい、ありがとうございます。…えへへ、ほめられちゃった。"
en: Thank you very much... Ehehe, I was praised.
en_grezzo: "Thank you very much... Ehehe, I was praised."
it: Grazie mille... Ehehe, sono stata lodata.

jp: ご主人様、お仕事お疲れ様です！
jp_grezzo: "ご主人様、お仕事お疲れ様です！"
en: Good work out there, Master!
en_grezzo: "Good work out there, Master!"
it: Buon lavoro là fuori, Padrone!

jp: 屋敷ごと買ってやる
jp_grezzo: "屋敷ごと買ってやる"
en: I'll buy the mansion.
en_grezzo: "I'll buy the mansion."
it: Compro io la villa

jp: はぁー…。え、どうしたのかって？実はご主人様が事業に失敗して借金まみれになってしまって。それで屋敷を売りに出すと同時に私たちメイドも全員解雇。ああ…新しいお仕事先探さないと。でもこの辺りで募集してるとこ、ないんですよねー…。
jp_grezzo: "はぁー…。え、どうしたのかって？実はご主人様が事業に失敗して借金まみれになってしまって。それで屋敷を売りに出すと同時に私たちメイドも全員解雇。ああ…新しいお仕事先探さないと。でもこの辺りで募集してるとこ、ないんですよねー…。"
en: *Sigh*... Huh? What's wrong? Well, my Master's business was unsuccessful and now he's drowning in debt. So, he put his mansion up for sale and fired us all at the same time. *Sigh*... Now I have to find a new job, but there's just doesn't seem to be any here...
en_grezzo: "*Sigh*... Huh? What's wrong? Well, my Master's business was unsuccessful and now he's drowning in debt. So, he put his mansion up for sale and fired us all at the same time. *Sigh*... Now I have to find a new job, but there's just doesn't seem to be any here..."
it: Ahh... Eh? Che c'è? Be', il mio padrone ha mandato all'aria i suoi affari e adesso è sommerso dai debiti. Così ha messo in vendita la villa e insieme ha licenziato tutte noi cameriere. Ahh... Adesso devo trovarmi un altro lavoro, ma qui intorno non cerca nessuno...

jp: さよならー…故郷のお母さんへの仕送りどうしよう…。臓器でも売るか！
jp_grezzo: "さよならー…故郷のお母さんへの仕送りどうしよう…。臓器でも売るか！"
en: Goodbye... Maybe I should just go back home and move in with my mom... Oh, I could sell my organs!
en_grezzo: "Goodbye... Maybe I should just go back home and move in with my mom... Oh, I could sell my organs!"
it: Arrivederci... Forse è meglio che torni a casa da mia madre... Ah, potrei sempre vendere gli organi!

jp: お気持ちは嬉しいですけど…今つけられてる屋敷の値段、金貨200万枚ですよ。そんなもの大富豪でもないと買えるわけが…。
jp_grezzo: "お気持ちは嬉しいですけど…今つけられてる屋敷の値段、金貨200万枚ですよ。そんなもの大富豪でもないと買えるわけが…。"
en: I appreciate the thought, but... The mansion is priced at 2 million gp. Only millionaires can afford this sort of thing...
en_grezzo: "I appreciate the thought, but... The mansion is priced at 2 million gp. Only millionaires can afford this sort of thing..."
it: Il pensiero mi fa piacere, ma... la villa è in vendita a due milioni di monete d'oro. Roba che se la può permettere solo un miliardario...

jp: この金で屋敷買える？
jp_grezzo: "この金で屋敷買える？"
en: Is this enough?
en_grezzo: "Is this enough?"
it: Bastano questi soldi?

jp: 新しいお仕事見つからない…。
jp_grezzo: "新しいお仕事見つからない…。"
en: I've got to find a new job...
en_grezzo: "I've got to find a new job..."
it: Devo trovarmi un altro lavoro...

jp: これは本格的に臓器売らなきゃー…。
jp_grezzo: "これは本格的に臓器売らなきゃー…。"
en: I might really have to start selling my organs...
en_grezzo: "I might really have to start selling my organs..."
it: Forse mi tocca davvero vendere gli organi...

jp: 安いね
jp_grezzo: "安いね"
en: That's cheap.
en_grezzo: "That's cheap."
it: Non è caro

jp: 考え直す
jp_grezzo: "考え直す"
en: Let me think on it.
en_grezzo: "Let me think on it."
it: Ci penso su

jp: うひゃあ！？す、すみません。変な声出ちゃいました。…こんな大金、見るの初めてです！これなら…。あ、でもでも！これとは別に維持費と人件費込みで毎月金貨6000枚ほどかかりますよ。それでも大丈夫ですか？
jp_grezzo: "うひゃあ！？す、すみません。変な声出ちゃいました。…こんな大金、見るの初めてです！これなら…。あ、でもでも！これとは別に維持費と人件費込みで毎月金貨6000枚ほどかかりますよ。それでも大丈夫ですか？"
en: Uwaah!? ...S-sorry about that just now. It's just the first time I've ever seen so much money! With this much, you can... Ah, but, but! It also costs 6000 gp a month for maintenance and personnel expenses. Is that okay?
en_grezzo: "Uwaah!? ...S-sorry about that just now. It's just the first time I've ever seen so much money! With this much, you can... Ah, but, but! It also costs 6000 gp a month for maintenance and personnel expenses. Is that okay?"
it: Uaah!? ...S-scusa, mi è scappato un verso strano. È la prima volta che vedo tanti soldi tutti insieme! Con questi si può... Ah, ma però! Ci sono anche seimila monete d'oro al mese di manutenzione e stipendi. Ti sta bene lo stesso?

jp: やっぱり高いですよねぇ。
jp_grezzo: "やっぱり高いですよねぇ。"
en: I knew it would be too much.
en_grezzo: "I knew it would be too much."
it: Lo sapevo che era troppo caro.

jp: わ、私とは金銭感覚が違いすぎる…っ！…えっと。屋敷は元のご主人様が売っているものなのでそちらに交渉しにいってください。今はルードゥスに住んでいるはずです。
jp_grezzo: "わ、私とは金銭感覚が違いすぎる…っ！…えっと。屋敷は元のご主人様が売っているものなのでそちらに交渉しにいってください。今はルードゥスに住んでいるはずです。"
en: T-That sort of attitude with money is so unfathomable for someone like me...! ...Ahem. My original Master is the one selling the mansion, so please go negotiate the payment with him. He lives in Ludus now.
en_grezzo: "T-That sort of attitude with money is so unfathomable for someone like me...! ...Ahem. My original Master is the one selling the mansion, so please go negotiate the payment with him. He lives in Ludus now."
it: I-io con i soldi ragiono in tutt'altro modo...! ...Ehm. La villa la vende il mio padrone di prima, quindi vai a trattare con lui. Adesso vive a Ludus.

jp: 一緒に解雇されたメイド仲間に、雇ってくれるかもしれない人がいるって連絡しないとなぁ。あ、ルードゥスはここからずっと東にある農村ですよ。
jp_grezzo: "一緒に解雇されたメイド仲間に、雇ってくれるかもしれない人がいるって連絡しないとなぁ。あ、ルードゥスはここからずっと東にある農村ですよ。"
en: I have to contact the maid friends who were dismissed together that someone might hire them. Oh, Ludus is a rural area ever far from here.
en_grezzo: "I have to contact the maid friends who were dismissed together that someone might hire them. Oh, Ludus is a rural area ever far from here."
it: Devo avvisare le colleghe licenziate insieme a me che forse c'è qualcuno disposto ad assumerle. Ah, Ludus è un borgo rurale molto più a est di qui.
